description: A JSON-RPC POST to /mcp while online reaches the handler: the edge's request (Host = public host, no Authorization) is turned into a web Request for https://<Host>/mcp with every end-to-end header, including mcp-session-id, unchanged. The handler's response without a Content-Length is framed chunked, then the agent CLOSEs its write side. MCPWARP.md §4
in:
POST /mcp HTTP/1.1
Host: notes-tester.mcpwarp.test
accept: application/json, text/event-stream
content-type: application/json
mcp-session-id: abc
user-agent: Go-http-client/1.1
Content-Length: 40

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
out:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

28
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
0
notes: Chunk boundaries are not normative (one chunk per body read); compare the de-chunked body. Content-Length is dropped from the headers the handler sees and recomputed by the web Request.
